scene: Beyond the rusted doorway lies Transit Hub.
picture: Flat side-view Transit Hub. Far left, the rusted doorway stands open. Left, a brass airship is tethered with its gangway down. Centre, the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair pauses. Right, an open round glass elevator glows blue. Far right, a pink striped steam train puffs white smoke along tracks.
shown: a tethered brass airship waiting with open hatch on the left
a glowing glass elevator capsule open on the right
a pink striped steam train puffing clouds on the far right
